inputs.name: sourceRoot
inputs.description: Repository-relative root of the original Japanese Markdown files.

inputs.name: outputRoot
inputs.description: Root containing mirrored Vietnamese translations and JSON caches.

inputs.name: exclude
inputs.description: Repository-relative globs of source documents whose outputs are no longer checked or synced.

inputs.name: glossary
inputs.description: Markdown file containing project terms and segment-matching rules.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Model used by the cache-synchronization skill.

inputs.name: timeoutMinutes
inputs.description: Time limit in minutes for each document's cache sync, per attempt.

inputs.name: maxTurns
inputs.description: Maximum Claude turns for each document's cache sync, per attempt.

inputs.name: maxBudgetUsd
inputs.description: Runaway guard in USD (API list price) for each document's cache sync, per attempt.

inputs.name: allowedTools
inputs.description: Claude tools of the cache-sync step; replaces the whole default list. Keep Bash(jq empty:*) and add only narrow Bash(<command>:*) rules.

inputs.name: toolkit
inputs.description: Complete replacement for the cache-sync skill, drift checker, and protected edit-plan checker.
